body: Microsoft Purview is a family of data governance, risk and compliance solutions that gives you a single, unified view of your data across on-premises, multicloud and software-as-a-service sources. It offers automated data discovery, sensitive data classification and end-to-end data lineage. These help you identify where sensitive data is stored in your data estate and build an up-to-date map of that estate. Purview is about understanding and governing data, not about controlling resource settings.
author: claude

body: Resource locks prevent resources being accidentally deleted or changed. A Delete lock lets authorized users read and modify a resource but not delete it. A ReadOnly lock lets authorized users read a resource but not delete or update it, like restricting everyone to the Reader role. Locks can be applied to a resource, resource group or subscription, and they are inherited by everything inside. Locks apply even to owners: to change a locked resource you must first remove the lock.
author: claude
